provenance.existing: tools/prepare-demo.cjs exports the approved Demo inputs, records a sha256 fingerprint of each and writes two generated files. This manifest classifies every file in design/ against that tool rather than restating it.
provenance.new: The classification of each file as runtime input, generated output or tooling is original work.
provenance.limits: A coverage map for the export tool. It does not change what the runtime renders and does not judge whether a design file is finished.

rules.everythingClassified: Every json file in design/ must appear here, so a new data file cannot be silently left out of the export
rules.inputsAreFingerprinted: A runtime input must be listed in prepare-demo's sourceFiles, or changing it will not invalidate the recorded baseline
rules.outputsAreGenerated: A generated output must never be hand-edited, because prepare-demo overwrites it
rules.toolingStaysOut: Checker and analysis artifacts are not shipped

categories.runtime_input: Shipped data the game reads; must be fingerprinted
categories.runtime_output: Written by prepare-demo from the inputs
categories.tooling: Checker, audit and simulation artifacts; never shipped

ownershipNote: brands.json, product-series.json and art-runtime.json belong to the brand and art workstreams. This manifest records that they are runtime inputs; whether and when their contents are ready to ship is theirs to decide.
